title: Hollow Deed — a quiet farming game with uneasy nights (one-minute preview)
author: SattuStudio
selftext:
I’m making Hollow Deed, a farming horror game where peaceful days give way to unsettling nights. Grow crops, explore the countryside, and get to know the locals—but keep an eye on what changes after dark.



This is an AI-assisted project. My experience so far: making farming work is only the beginning; making it feel satisfying takes repeated playtesting and refinement. The current focus is the feel of plowing, planting and watering, alongside the shift from welcoming daylight to uneasy nights.



Muted, spoiler-free one-minute preview: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PR5dFqfpegg](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PR5dFqfpegg)



Project page and devlog: [https://sattustudio.itch.io/hollow-deed](https://sattustudio.itch.io/hollow-deed)



Still in development; no public download yet.
